segments.narration: On the eighteenth of August, 1976, a small work party started pruning a poplar. North Korean soldiers attacked them with axes.
Two American officers died. Bonifas and Barrett. The tree had been blocking the sightline between a checkpoint and an observation post.
Three days later the UN Command came back to finish the job. Engineers, special forces, 27 helicopters, fighters overhead, bombers behind them.
The tree came down in 42 minutes. Nobody fired. North Korea then accepted responsibility, which it had not done once since 1953.
